motivation: M7.8 demonstrated a small direct fixed-geometry energy effect of native bond conduction versus sham, but generic nonbonded conduction led to more recruitment. Is the specific particle-by-particle energy PLACEMENT produced by the naturally bonded network advantageous compared to counterfactual placements with EXACTLY the same post-conduction energy multiset within that same native aggregate?

sample.independent_unit: one numeric native source seed; four permutation placements and 32 pair-keyed chemistry lotteries share the same native original geometry and are repeated within-seed conditions, not independent samples
sample.source: Use exact unchanged M7.5 first eligible original material-ID source: native original M7.3 no_transfer parent with 264 native particles, zero initial bonds, 24x24 periodic, dispersed external sources; first maximal bonded 5..16 material component ≥4 native bonds and ≥1 free-valence member, ≥2 source edges continuously unbroken ≥20 ticks, first selection from tick120 through tick500, lexicographically lowest IDs, retain all nulls.

interventions.sham: Clone parent, no energy conduction. Controls baseline untransferred energy state.
interventions.bond_only: Clone parent and apply EXACTLY ONE native M7.3 energy_transfer(...,'bond_only') pass with no World.advance, movement, injection, bond formation/breaking or RNG draw.
interventions.root_scramble: Start from the SAME post-bond_only complete world. Take EXACT vector of all source-original-ID particle energy values, and assign those values to the same original ID set according to a frozen deterministic per-seed rank permutation. This preserves EXACT per-original-cohort energy multiset, mean, sum, nonnegative energies; all outside original-source energy values, all pre-reaction positions/species/bonds/degree, native total energy and M7.3 number of transfers. Only mapping ENERGY→material ID differs. This is an artificial spatial placement ABLATION, not an implementable native energy-routing physical law.
interventions.permutation_key: For each original material ID independently compute SHA256 ASCII 'alife-m7-9|'+seed+'|'+rank+'|'+material_id, sort by (digest_bytes, material_id); use this ordered target-ID list to assign the source energies listed in ascending original-ID order. The identity permutation is possible; report unchanged-energy placebo counts.
interventions.frozen: Never mutate actual native source world; no material movements, additions, removals, topology/degree edits, or RNG consumption before chemistry.

chemistry.mode: EXACT isolated M7.8 experimental one-sweep formation_only_pair_keyed using native M6 chemistry candidate iteration, formation_threshold/cost/rechecks, with SAME pair-specific SHA256 draw across conditions; NO original World.advance. No changes to original M6 physics.
chemistry.seeds_for_pair_draw: unchanged M7.8 pair_draw using new numeric seed 27001..27640, salt0..31, original unordered material IDs
chemistry.lottery_salts: exact integers 0..31, fixed before data, every seed+intervention uses the same paired draws for identical original material pairs
chemistry.outcome: Count original-to-outside new bond formations, not global bonds; keep all 32 lottery-level outcomes and full final hashes. Same source is a single independent unit.

measurements.static: pre original source, sham, post bond conduction, post each root-scramble: native unbonded original–external cardinal contacts, chemically permitted species/valence subset, energy-qualified subset requiring BOTH endpoints sufficient native formation_cost; compare original bond_only to average four scrambles.
measurements.budget: Record exact original-root energy vector + posttransfer root vector, original bond-pass count, original-root total and sorted energy multiset, exterior energy vector checksum, root mapping and actual changed-target count for each scramble.
measurements.real_chemical: Each of sham/bond_only/4 scrambles undergo 32 paired M7.8 isolated native-chemistry sweeps; original-to-external new bonds in each, all new bonds, final hashes, same-pair lottery matching by fixed SHA key.
measurements.reporting: Per source difference bond_only energetic qualified contact count minus mean four shuffled positions, and bond_only 32-salt actual new original–external formation count minus four-rank mean. Do NOT count 4×32 attempts as extra independent worlds.
measurements.invariance: All five conduction-descended arms must preserve entire M7.3 post-conduction particle-energy multiset for root, total root energy, all non-root energy exact, all IDs/species/positions/chemical bonds, full original RNG/draw counts. Formation sweeps conserve world ledger. Sham total energy also same though per-particle distribution differs.
measurements.controls: First selected native source of each shard independently regenerated from seed and replays original M7.3 one-pass + one M7.8 lottery on sham/bond and first scramble to confirm raw hashes. Four shuffled ranks deterministic and preregistered; all 640 worlds including nulls archived.

gates.primary: At least 40 naturally selected independent seed worlds and 25 non-tied seed-level cases on 4*bond_only_energetically_qualified_external_pairs minus SUM(ranks0to3_qualified_external_pairs). ≥2/3 non-tied must favor original bond-only placement. Else no_success (explicitly flag sample insufficiency if <25).
gates.secondary: At least 40 selected source worlds and 20 non-tied seed-level cases on 4*SUM_32[bond_only_new_original-external_bonds] minus SUM_over_4rank_SUM_32[scrambled_new_original-external_bonds]. ≥2/3 non-tied favorable original bond-only placement. Else no_success, distinguish underpowered when <20.
gates.sham_comparison: Original bond_only vs sham and pooled scramble vs sham remain DESCRIPTIVE and must NOT replace primary/secondary.
